requirements.demand: Distinguish the directed velocity state from scalar speed and reconstruct velocity from signed components.
Track signed component evolution through rising, apex and falling states without treating the apex as zero acceleration or zero total velocity.
Translate the current signed component pair into instantaneous velocity direction with correct quadrant/sign semantics.
Reconstruct scalar speed from vector components and identify the apex minimum-speed condition without setting total speed to zero.
Discriminate same-height speed symmetry from velocity-vector equality by preserving v_x and reversing the sign of v_y.
Represent two velocity vectors in one frame and translate perpendicularity into a signed dot-product condition.
Use a declared displacement origin and no-time vertical relation to recover v_y at height, then reconstruct total speed with constant v_x.
